W.note: Catch's kick and Plant's long tail give real clinging, with labeled graphs, live readouts, a pause control and a reference track, though Plant and Snap are similar ease-outs and the Catch overshoot is shallow.

X.note: Balls ping-pong on infinite alternate with no hold at either end, so nothing lingers, and there are no graphs, values, pause control or per-curve reading, only the spec line.

Y.note: The three curve shapes are the most varied and Sticky Anticipation's wind-up is genuinely sticky, but the Punch and Settle graphs are clipped at the top, dots clip at the track edges, loops hard-reset instead of returning, and the JS ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

Z.note: Press, Release and Settle are clearly different, each card shows a playhead, progress value, phase label and mirrored return on the curve, and the Settle slow grip reads as sticky, with reduced motion starting paused and mobile working.
